CVE-2026-85732 (GHSA-h7vf-4x9w-h99v, GO-2026-6497): oras-go's pagination helper parseLink (package registry/remote) followed the URL in a registry's Link response header without checking its scheme or host, so a malicious registry could make a client that lists tags, referrers or repositories send GET requests to an arbitrary host, including internal network addresses (blind server-side request forgery). It affects oras.land/oras-go/v2 up to and including 2.6.1 and is fixed in 2.6.2 by commit 31da1963 (https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/commit/31da1963f8c327dd089cd29faeae95cf0fc50842), which rejects next-page URLs whose scheme, host or port differ from the original request. Sources: https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/security/advisories/GHSA-h7vf-4x9w-h99v, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6497 and https://github.com/oras-project/oras-go/releases/tag/v2.6.2. We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 28 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (50 packages), each against the checksum in the repository index. Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We read the program in full from every package, except 1.26.0-r3, whose program has the same SHA-1 checksum, recorded in its package header, as the 1.26.0-r2 program we read. The -dev program is built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath; its Go release and module versions are the same as those of the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same build. Its Go build information, the same on both architectures, lists oras.land/oras-go/v2 v2.6.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v2.6.2 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.30.0-r0, with no replace directive for that module. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows the vulnerable function, oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote.parseLink, linked in every build. The builds before 1.23.1-r1 carry v2.6.0, in the affected range, and every build from 1.23.1-r1 on carries v2.6.2, which contains the fix commit (no build carries 2.6.1), so 1.23.1-r1 is the first fixed build.
